multilingual_lor_bridge.description: For LIS faculty (e.g. David Nah, Kyu Mun Hwang, Peter Yoo) drafting recommendations in Korean. Gemini AI transforms raw Korean notes into academic admissions English for counselor and headmaster review.
multilingual_lor_bridge.sample_raw_teacher_notes: 학생은 LIS 고등부 재학 기간 동안 학업에 매우 성실하고 지적 호기심이 탁월했습니다. 특히 수학과 물리, 컴퓨터 과학 분야에서 뛰어난 분석력을 발휘하며, 실험 오차가 발생했을 때 끈기 있게 원인을 규명하는 과학적 태도를 보였습니다. 급우들을 배려하고 섬기는 리더십 또한 매우 모범적입니다.
multilingual_lor_bridge.ai_converted_english_draft: "It is a distinct privilege to recommend this student on behalf of the faculty at Leaders International School. Throughout her academic tenure, she has distinguished herself as a scholar of exceptional intellectual vitality and rigorous analytical integrity. In advanced mathematics, physical sciences, and computing, she demonstrates exemplary perseverance, methodically dissecting discrepancies rather than faltering under empirical challenges. Beyond her scholastic brilliance, she is a humble, compassionate leader who actively uplifts her peers. She epitomizes the highest standards of academic excellence and global leadership."
